author: Al3cs
text:
You can trade it at FTB but until you have not an eng of the lower
flag you're shorting in an uptrend (I know, "trend" is a word that means
 nothing here, but just for explain the concept), so you have to manage
your expectations.

Usually I trade this kind of setup with the "FTR trade": I try to take the move from FTBs of opposite FTRs.

You should find some example in my journal too.
